title: Quasi-compactness is local on the target
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $Y=\bigcup_i Y_i$ is an open cover and each restricted morphism $f^{-1}(Y_i)\to Y_i$ is quasi-compact, then $f$ is quasi-compact.
